title: Coincidence is not cause
literal_meaning: The palm fruit falls as the crow calls.
explanation: Two events occurring together can be mistaken for cause and effect. The crow’s call and the falling fruit provide a compact warning against that leap.
meaning_odia: ଦୁଇଟି ଘଟଣା ଏକା ସମୟରେ ଘଟିଲେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅନ୍ୟଟିର କାରଣ ବୋଲି ଧରିବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A machine stops just as someone enters; that timing alone does not show they caused it. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
